Player Impressions:
Hoyos - Couldn't have stopped the goal.  has made several good punch-outs.  Organizing the bakline on corners
Edwards - His own goal ☠️ was a one worthy of a striker.  Great position, aim, power.  He's recovered since then and making a lot of trouble down the right.  Needs to work on his crossing.
Jacob - doing well as a CB tonight.  Better in this position than a RB.  Also covering LB.  
Mihaj - I'm not thrilled with this performance so far.  He hasn't put a foot wrong, but hasn't done much well either.  
Báez - He's showing up all over the place.  He is getting overloaded on his side.  He's switching frequently with Sanchez, Muyumba, Jacob.  
Sanchez - good when he comes back defensively, reading passes well.  Cannot get the ball forward that well.  
Amaro - He gets frustrated quckly.  This will cost him.  He's under-performing in midfield.  The game is too fast tonight, he's unable to connect his passes.
Muyumba - he is trying things.  Unable to connect his passes.  Need something more from him.  He is doing more defensive work than getting the ball forward
Galoppo - He's frquently been in the right place, right time.  Including for the goal.  I really like how he reads the game.  Can be getting the ball forward more.  
Embolo - Atlanta can't get the ball to him.  He's making a nuisance of himself for the NYCFC backline and midfield.  It's more about creating team chances.  Could be more selfish.
Brennan - I like what I'm seeing from him when he's on the ball.  He gets the ball forward well, making great runs.  But the final ball is just not there.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - nothing special.  
Edwards - had the own goal ☠️, moved the ball well up the pitch, couldn't send in a good cross.
Jacob - He was the best defensive player.  His sub was most likely pre-arranged.  
Mihaj - under performed tonight in a start.  He needs to show up big when he does get the start.  Hampered by an injury late but stayed out to see out the draw.
Báez - his position was all over the place.  He was frequently overrun when in defense.  Tata eventually moved him into a wide CAM spot.  Didn't really do much
Sanchez - did what he could down the left.  Moved the ball up.  Wasn't able to connect his final passes.   Too defensive.
Amaro - He kept popping up defensively to shut down passes.  At the time, I didn't think much of his play but he did help keep NYCFC out of midfield.
Muyumba - uninspiring tonight.  didn't control midfield, unable to get passes up the pitch.  unsure of what he was playing.  CM, DM, CAM?
Galoppo - without the goal, he did alright.  Read passes well, trying some fabulous balls.  Couldn't connect.  Not sure if he just expects players to be there, or simply doesn't look.  If it starts connecting - look out
Embolo - Another night where his biggest contribution is his holdup play.  Did Atlanta get a striker or a CAM?
Brennan - His normal evaluation.  He is a tremendously hard worker . Gets the ball up the pitch, makes a nuisance of himself and fights for everything. But he simply cannot put the final ball where it needs to go.

subs:
Fortune - looked good after coming on.  moved the ball around well, finding targets that were unexpected.  Was in the right spot for a good shot.  Lucky to get the goal.
Alzate - no real impact, but the team went down to 10 shortly after he arrived
Dunbar - a couple of sparks.  But his potential was cut short when Atlanta went down to 10.  
Chica - Chica looked like he belonged with the team.  He was in control, passed well.  Looked sharp.  He deserved the callup.  He now has a few weeks of recovery before the 2's first playoff match.
